desc: This armorers tool kit will provide all the tools needed to build a gun from scratch, or to add enhanced features onto your already existing firearm. The kit includes: Armorer's Master Wrench, Lug-Lok Upper Vice Block, Lower Vise Block, Mater Bench Block, Torque Wrench, Easy-Grip Handguard Tool, Pivot Pin Tool, Punch Set, Accu-Grip Picks, Safety Flag, Front Sight Adjustment Tool. Also includes an AR15 Pivot Lock/AR15 Pin Punch Set/Pin Alignment Tool/Bore Illuminator. All this stores in a professional tool case.
